questions.prompt: Which format specifier prints an int with printf?
What is the index of the first element of a C array?
What does sizeof(char) evaluate to in C?
questions.explanation: The standard defines sizeof(char) as exactly 1.

questions.prompt: After int *p = malloc(10 * sizeof(int)); free(p); what does executing *p = 5; do?
options: Safely writes to the freed block
Leaks memory but is otherwise defined
questions.explanation: Accessing memory after free is undefined behaviour and a common source of security bugs.
